7529: Gated RV park in Frankston, about 10 minutes from Lake Palestine and 20 miles from Tyler, with large sites for big rigs, for short and long stays. --Claude
7534: Overnight RV park on Jones Road northwest of Bryan, about 6 miles from Texas A&M, with concrete pads, paved roads, a clubhouse and two dog parks: 48 back-in sites and 20 pull-throughs. --Claude
7535: Large RV resort at San Leon on a bayou that leads to Galveston Bay, with waterfront sites, room for big rigs, two pools, two fishing piers, stocked ponds and a 15-slip marina, for stays from one night to a season. --Claude
7537: RV park on US 84 in Joaquin, near the Louisiana line about a mile from the Logansport bridge over the Sabine, with a clubhouse and a pavilion, within walking distance of a grocery and fast food.  Every overnight guest must register through the park's online application and be approved by the manager. --Claude
7543: Large RV resort, formerly Road Host RV Park, off I-10 in Anthony on the edge of El Paso, with oversized level gravel pads, two dog parks and covered storage; it caters to extended stays but takes nightly bookings too. --Claude
7545: RV park on the southwest side of Beaumont off US 69/96/287, with level big-rig pull-throughs, a pool and a free continental breakfast. --Claude
7546: Gated RV park in San Leon near Galveston Bay, about 15 minutes from the Kemah Boardwalk, with a fishing pond and an outdoor kitchen. --Claude
7549: Luxury RV resort at Matagorda Harbor, next to the public boat launch and marina about 500 yards from the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, with a pool and a clubhouse. --Claude
7593: Wooded 10-acre RV park on the south edge of Bryan, across from the Brazos County Expo Center, with a dog park and walking trails in the woods, for short and long stays. --Claude
7601: Small private RV park between two stocked fishing ponds in Jewett, with level sites, for a night or by the week or month. --Claude
7608: Gated 44-acre RV resort off FM 713 near Dale, overlooking private Tinney Lake, where fishing is catch and release, with big-rig sites, tiny houses for rent, a pool and a hot tub. --Claude
7623: Coastal RV resort at Crystal Beach on the Bolivar Peninsula, with canal-front sites off Galveston Bay, a pool and a clubhouse.  The Gulf beach, a drive-on beach that needs a county pass, is across Highway 87 through Camp Margaritaville, whose pool and activities guests can buy a pass to. --Claude
7624: Overnight RV park on the Highway 6 frontage road about 8 miles from Texas A&M in College Station, with 13 pull-throughs and 22 back-ins, cable TV, a bathhouse, a dog area, cowboy bunkhouses and private rooms; it fills up for Aggie football games. --Claude
7664: Private campground on Toledo Bend Reservoir in the Sabine National Forest near Hemphill, with 6 lakefront cabins and vacation homes, a private boat ramp, covered and open boat slips, a fish-cleaning station and a swimming platform; all the RV sites are pull-throughs. --Claude
7682: RV resort on a peninsula of Lake Leon near Eastland, 7 miles off I-20, with about 2,500 feet of shoreline, a dock, a boat ramp, a playground and a public 18-hole golf course next door. --Claude
7696: Small RV park on US 67, the main road through Glen Rose, near Dinosaur Valley State Park and the Paluxy and Brazos rivers, with large sites, for a night or long stays. --Claude
7714: RV park in the coastal fishing town of Port O'Connor, with restrooms, a rally room, a dog park, a playground, a pool and a hot tub. --Claude
7726: Gated RV park in Hondo, about 30 minutes west of San Antonio, with large landscaped lots, back-ins and pull-throughs, and weekly and monthly stays as well as nightly ones. --Claude
7735: Coastal RV resort, Coastal Cowboy Redfish Bay, off Highway 361 where Aransas Pass meets Ingleside, near Redfish Bay, with level concrete sites for big rigs, a clubhouse and fenced boat and trailer storage. --Claude
7739: Small private RV park on Turtle Bayou just off I-10 at Wallisville, with restrooms, a playground and a few tent sites, for a night or by the week or month. --Claude
7758: Destination RV park on 15 acres in Carmine, about 7 miles from historic Round Top and its antiques shows, formerly Dixieland RV Park, with a central bathhouse, a dog park and two catch-and-release ponds. --Claude
